solutions.check: 32 entries; each light the paper's grid did not give solved here from its clue's wordplay (an anagram or hidden word, the one listed word fitting every crossing) and its definition (WordNet), agrees with the 31 answers the paper printed

clue.text: Drink brought back by mother from holiday resort

indicators.note: something brought back returns the way it came, so the word for drink is read backwards

parts.note: to lap is to drink as a cat does
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone carries a drink back home for their mother from a sunny holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns LAP into PAL. Palma is the capital of Majorca, a popular Spanish holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: Palma on Majorca is a well-known Mediterranean tourist destination.

clue.text: Make a bomb from fruit under tree

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece under another is written below it

parts.note: a pine is a coniferous tree
an apple is a fruit

explanation.surface: Someone builds an explosive device out of fruit found beneath a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' puts APPLE below PINE in this down entry. A pineapple is old military slang for a hand grenade, from its shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers called a hand grenade by this name because of its segmented, fruit-like casing.

clue.text: Scowl when let down

definitions.meaning: to frown or look sullen and threatening

explanation.surface: Someone frowns on being disappointed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for frowning darkly (also spelt lour) and the verb for bringing something down.

clue.text: Notice works getting into shape for a take-over

parts.note: an ad, a notice in a paper, is a short form of advertisement
op is short for opus, a musical work

indicators.note: putting something into a new shape rearranges it, so the letters of the word before are reordered

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A public notice says the factory is being reorganised ahead of a corporate buyout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' looks like part of 'getting into shape' but is the fodder: 'shape' rearranges INTO to TION.
explanation.definitionFit: Adopting a child means taking it over as your own.

clue.text: Reformed lags swear anyone can see through this

indicators.note: reformed means made over into a new shape, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Old convicts who have gone straight curse at a transparent object.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reformed' looks like it describes the lags (British slang for convicts) going straight, but it signals rearranging the letters of LAGS SWEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Glass objects are transparent, so the definition describes them by what they let you do.

clue.text: A song can give great pleasure

definitions.meaning: a part-song for several unaccompanied voices

explanation.surface: Singing can bring lots of joy.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a part-song for men's voices and also exuberant delight.

clue.text: Mid-morning Daniel goes to church gate

parts.note: at ten o'clock is roughly the middle of the morning
Dan is a short form of the name Daniel
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Late in the morning Daniel heads off to the churchyard entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gate' is not a doorway but the number of spectators at a sports match, as in a gate of 20,000.
explanation.definitionFit: The crowd figure at a sporting event is called its gate, from the turnstile takings.

clue.text: Fights waste

definitions.meaning: leftover bits of food or material

explanation.surface: Battles squander everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Small scuffles and leftover morsels share the same plural noun.

clue.text: A key company worker is one who stands by his word

definitions.text: one who stands by his word

parts.note: F is a musical key
a firm is a business company
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A vital employee at a business always keeps promises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key' looks like an adjective meaning important but is the musical key F.
explanation.definitionFit: In law this is a person who solemnly declares rather than swears an oath, standing by their statement.

clue.text: Bird in regrettable condition

indicators.note: the bird's letters sit in the word that follows, as part of it

explanation.surface: A bird is found in a sorry state.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird is tucked inside 'regrettable'; 'condition' just completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a white heron, a wading bird.

clue.text: A home should include quarters for wood

indicators.note: one word containing others is said to include them, so the home goes around the rest

parts.note: a nest is a home, for birds
east and west are two of the compass quarters, written E and W
taken as written

explanation.surface: A house ought to have rooms set aside for timber.
explanation.walkthrough: The compass points E and W plus FOR go inside NEST. The New Forest is an ancient woodland in Hampshire, southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Forest is a large historic tract of woodland and heath in southern England.

clue.text: Advert about iron, right?

parts.note: re means concerning or about
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether an advertisement about an iron is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advert' is not the noun for an advertisement here but the formal verb meaning to allude or turn attention to.
explanation.definitionFit: To advert to a matter is to mention or allude to it, a verb sense rarely heard now.

clue.text: Lend a certain sparkle

parts.note: read literally, giving a liquid its fizz by forcing gas into it, rather than adding charm to something

explanation.definitionFit: Charging a drink with gas bubbles makes it fizzy, giving it sparkle.

clue.text: Esoteric drink to encourage

parts.note: something esoteric is known only to those in the know, as with an in-joke
spirit is strong drink such as whisky or gin

explanation.surface: A mysterious beverage is used to raise people's courage.
explanation.definitionFit: To fill someone with spirit or animation is to hearten or rouse them.

clue.text: Turn the corner and create pure chaos

indicators.note: chaos is complete disorder, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A driver rounds a bend and causes total pandemonium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn the corner' looks like driving, but it means to begin recovering from illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn the corner after illness is to start getting better, to regain health.

clue.text: Taking new help on, mean to produce miraculous result

indicators.note: new means made afresh, so the letters of the following words are put into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone hires an assistant and intends to work wonders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' looks like it describes the help being taken on, but it signals rearranging the letters of HELP ON MEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something phenomenal is extraordinary, almost beyond belief, like a wonder.

clue.text: Questioning people

parts.note: not the act of quizzing folk but those whose job is to set test questions

explanation.definitionFit: Those who set and mark tests are people who ask the questions.

clue.text: Suspend for, quite a mild imprecation

definitions.meaning: to suspend is to attach something so it dangles from above
a gentle oath of exasperation, as in 'it all!' or 'the expense!'

explanation.surface: Someone is stopped from swearing in favour of a gentle curse.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to dangle something, and the same word is a softened oath like 'damn'.

clue.text: Cut before the consumer can get warmer

indicators.note: one piece before another means it comes first

parts.note: a gash is a deep cut
an eater is one who consumes

explanation.surface: Prices are slashed so that shoppers can afford a heater.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire burning fuel from the mains supply is a domestic heater.

clue.text: A form giving rise to extreme dislike

parts.note: a version is one form of something

explanation.surface: A particular document leads to intense hatred.
explanation.definitionFit: Aversion is strong repugnance or antipathy.

clue.text: Forced to return the cheese

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the word for forced is read backwards

parts.note: to be made to do something is to be forced to do it

explanation.surface: Someone was compelled to take back the cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is a mild Dutch cheese with a red wax coating.

clue.text: Russian capitalists!

parts.note: not money-makers but people who live in the Russian capital city

explanation.definitionFit: Natives of Moscow, the Russian capital, are by a pun its capitalists.

clue.text: Dedicated old boy no longer alive

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
the late so-and-so is someone who has died

explanation.surface: A devoted former pupil has passed away.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblate is a person devoted to religious life, and as an adjective it means consecrated.

clue.text: Footballer behaving like a baby?

parts.note: a player who runs the ball past opponents with small touches, and also an infant who lets saliva run from its mouth

explanation.definitionFit: A footballer who runs with the ball under close control is one; so is a slobbering infant.

clue.text: Drawing many a primitive means of transport

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
a raft is a basic floating platform for travel

explanation.surface: Sketching lots of crude old vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a preliminary sketch or plan.

clue.text: Twist a guy after a court order

indicators.note: one piece coming after another means it is placed behind it

parts.note: a writ is a formal written order issued by a court
he is a pronoun for a man or guy

explanation.surface: A man is wrung out after being served with a legal summons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts HE behind WRIT, though the clue mentions the guy first.
explanation.definitionFit: To writhe is to squirm and contort the body, as in pain.

clue.text: Pluck is called for to make such a sound

definitions.text: Pluck is called for to make such a sound

parts.words: Pluck is called for to make such a sound
parts.note: pluck reads as courage, but here it is plucking a string, which makes a ringing, vibrating noise

explanation.definitionFit: The resonant noise of a plucked string, or a nasal accent, is this.

clue.text: As one's written repeatedly, she was highly respected

indicators.note: repeatedly means said or done again, so the piece is written twice

parts.note: one is I, and the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: Like someone's repeated writing, she was much esteemed.
explanation.walkthrough: One is the Roman numeral I, so one's gives IS; written twice it names the Egyptian goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian goddess of magic and motherhood was venerated throughout the ancient world.

clue.text: Pole in space — a scene of much action

indicators.note: one piece in another means it sits inside it

parts.note: an area is a space or expanse
N stands for the North Pole

explanation.surface: A pole planted in open ground marks where something dramatic happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts N inside AREA. 'Pole' looks like a stick or a person from Poland; it is the north pole, N.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is a stadium or setting for conflict, where the action happens.

clue.text: Like list to include really good aggressive man

parts.note: as means like, in a comparison

indicators.note: one word including another means it holds it inside

parts.note: to list is to lean or slant, as a ship does
A1 means first-class, and the figure 1 is read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A list ought to feature someone truly excellent and pushy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' puts AI inside SLANT. AI is the crossword spelling of A1, first-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: An attacker is someone who launches a violent assault on another person.

clue.text: Settles as arranged for flat

indicators.note: arranged means put in order, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone sorts out the details for an apartment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is part of the letters to be rearranged, not a link: SETTLES plus AS. 'flat' looks like an apartment but means dull or insipid.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat food or drink lacks savour, so it is insipid in the mouth.

clue.text: Engineers with hoist take a turn running water

indicators.note: taking a turn means facing about, so the two pieces together are read backwards

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army
a gin is a hoisting machine, as on an old crane

explanation.surface: Army engineers with lifting gear turn a corner by a stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take a turn' turns REGIN around as one run. The Niger is a great river of West Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niger is a major West African river, flowing water by another name.
